source.name: Lucas's AltStore Gallery
source.subtitle: AltGallery plus Lucas's own picks
source.description: A personal AltStore source. It mirrors the AltGallery list (https://github.com/bebound/AltGallery) and adds apps chosen by Lucas, each built from its GitHub Releases.

app.name: GestaltX
app.subtitle: MobileGestalt editor for iOS 27 (unofficial fork)
app.localizedDescription:
Includes beta builds as well as stable releases. Beta builds are for development use only and may be unstable or incomplete.

A MobileGestalt editor for iPhone and iPad, with region-code tweaks, device presets, a CacheExtra field editor, automatic backups and per-preset restore.

This is an unofficial fork, Lucas04-nhr/GestaltX, of huamidev/GestaltX. It follows the upstream releases and adds:

• Backups tab: create, import, restore, open, rename and export backups in one place. Imports are verified against this device, and restores require a matching system cache layout.
• Check Unofficial Settings: a read-only check in Tools that lists values not official for this device, such as internal flags or unsupported features, and can stage fixes for review.
• Builds with the App Group entitlements of the app and its share extension embedded, so SideStore and AltStore can set up the App Group themselves. When re-signing with another tool, keep the share extension and give the app and the extension the same App Group.

On-device MobileGestalt access requires iOS / iPadOS 27.x; on iOS 26.x only local plist editing works. Report issues with the fork's changes to Lucas04-nhr/GestaltX and all others upstream.

For security research and educational purposes only. Use it only on devices you own or are authorized to manage.

app.name: LiveContainer
app.subtitle: Run iOS apps without actually installing them!
app.localizedDescription:
Run iOS apps without actually installing them!

This is the standalone build, without the built-in SideStore. Install it with AltStore, SideStore or another signer, and refresh it from there.

app.name: SideStore
app.subtitle: Untethered alternative app store for iOS
app.localizedDescription:
An untethered, community-driven alternative app store for non-jailbroken iOS devices. It re-signs and installs IPA files with your own Apple ID and refreshes them in the background, without AltServer.

Only stable releases are listed here. See https://docs.sidestore.io for setup instructions.

app.name: Kelivo
app.subtitle: LLM chat client
app.localizedDescription: A Flutter LLM chat client for mobile and desktop.

app.name: Ksign
app.subtitle: On-device IPA signer
app.localizedDescription: The "cleaner" ESign app: sign and install IPAs on the device with your own certificate, no computer needed.

app.name: Asspp
app.subtitle: Multi-account App Store manager
app.localizedDescription:
Manage several Apple IDs across App Store regions: switch stores, search apps, download official IPAs including older versions, and keep them in a local library, without signing out on the device.

Downloads go through Apple's servers with your own Apple ID, using the same protocol as ipatool. A secondary account is recommended.

app.name: Zhihu--
app.subtitle: Lightweight, ad-free Zhihu client
app.localizedDescription:
Zhihu-- is a lightweight, ad-free third-party Zhihu client built with React Native (Expo). It supports multiple accounts, a guest mode, custom theme colors and dark mode, and shows the hot list, recommendations, answers, articles, pins and comments.

The app's interface is in Chinese.

app.name: PPSSPP
app.subtitle: PSP emulator
app.localizedDescription: A cross-platform PSP emulator written in C++. See https://ppsspp.org for the full changelog.

app.name: Provenance
app.subtitle: Multi-system emulator frontend
app.localizedDescription:
An iOS and tvOS multi-emulator frontend supporting various Atari, Bandai, NEC, Nintendo, Sega, SNK and Sony console systems.

Each download is about 1 GB. Get started with the wiki at https://wiki.provenance-emu.com.

app.name: JHenTai
app.subtitle: E-Hentai and ExHentai client
app.localizedDescription:
A cross-platform manga app for E-Hentai and ExHentai, made with Flutter.

The content on these sites is mostly for adults.
